हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: Kusum, an 18-year-old working-class girl, endures relentless humiliation and exploitation from the wealthy Kapoor family, unaware she is their lost daughter, Sheena. Forced into desperate choices and framed for crimes she didn’t commit, she fights to survive. A DNA revelation exposes impostor Zoya and reunites Kusum with her true family, restoring the identity and love stolen from her. Watch now.
